Meta writer brain for a second: I know OP is satirizing a lot of Harry/Kim media, but I’ve been playing this completely straight because I genuinely think the writing is brilliant. Satire that still manages to hit this hard is incredibly difficult to pull off. You have to understand the thing intimately enough to know which parts can be exaggerated without losing the emotional truth underneath them.
“Heart’s tender underbelly” is funny in context, but it’s also such an exact description of what loving Harry would mean for Kim. All that vastness and need and terrible openness, and the part of him that is still painfully soft despite everything. The joke doesn’t cancel out the tenderness. If anything, the compression makes it land harder. OP keeps getting to something real before the satire can protect me from it.
